notes: NovaShell’s local setup and radio workflow are clearer: first-run navigation is actionable, Orbit’s station rail stays complete, and the live Project Board continues to report progress without reloads.
changes: First-run setup now loads reliably, takes priority over the retro bulletin, and ends with direct Library, owned-game, backup, and controller-help shortcuts.
Orbit’s desktop channel rail now fills its available height: search and filters stay visible while the full station list scrolls independently.
Orbit station names and ON AIR status use improved readable radio-display plates across dense visuals and Ultra Retro.
Relay shows each provider route’s best use, free-tier or account limits, data boundary, and the difference between drafting and the separately confirmed Local Codex runner.
Project Board is a live one-way Relay build chat that polls the local feed every 1.2 seconds, so task moves and implementation notes arrive without a reload.
Utility Desk includes a no-network workspace handoff manifest for folder inventories and SHA-256 fingerprints.
